name: copilotprompts-prompt-m365-ai-profile
title: Generate a Portable AI Profile as HTML
shortDescription: Generate a portable HTML profile that helps AI tools understand your role, goals, work style, communication preferences, and expectations.
longDescription: This prompt creates a structured, self-contained HTML profile from your previous AI interactions. The profile captures practical observations about your role, goals, communication preferences, work style, technical strengths, decision-making patterns, and expectations so other AI tools can provide more personalized and consistent responses.

thumbnails.alt: Generated portable AI profile displayed as a styled HTML page
